prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Finish First Interaction Playground Screen: Add a new interactive pet control practice screen immediately after home intro where users test hiding, dragging, and chatting with their desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_finish_playground"], "new_finish_playground": {"headline": "Try Controlling Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Practice dragging, hiding, and talking to your pet right here before finishing setup.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "playful", "text": "Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls or hide it to system tray."}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Safeguard Guidance Hint: Add a reminder hint on sign_in instructing users to log in with their original auth method to prevent duplicate empty accounts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account method to keep your adopted pet and saved settings."}}
2: [home, redesign] Desktop Launch Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout with notification alerts and desktop tray troubleshooting hints during setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace", "body": "We are placing your pet on your desktop. If your pet is not visible, check your system tray.", "notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Post Home Companion Controls Flow: Insert a dedicated companion controls guide step at the end of onboarding highlighting desktop tray and shortcut controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_companion_guide"], "new_companion_guide": {"headline": "Desktop Companion Quick Controls", "body": "Double-click your pet to chat, drag to reposition, or right-click to send to system tray.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "text": "Desktop Control Tip"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection AI Pet Generation Hint: Display a hint on choose_path explaining the difference between pre-made pets and photo-based custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Pre-made pets load immediately, while custom pets use photo upload during adoption."}}
5: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Quality Guidance Wait Info: Provide photo quality guidelines and format hints directly on the upload_photos screen to prevent broken custom pet outputs.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload a Clear Pet Photo", "body": "Use a clear, well-lit photo facing forward for the best pet generation result.", "hint": "Supported formats: PNG, JPG. Ensure the pet subject is well-centered."}}
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Visibility Guidance Copy: Update home_intro text to clearly direct users where to locate their newly rendered pet on their screen or system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Check your desktop corner or system tray icons to see your pet. Right-click anytime for options."}}
7: [choose_path, reorder] Path First Story Reorder Journey: Reorder the onboarding flow so choose_path comes before story, letting users pick their intent immediately.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Profile Restore Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores existing pets and guards against progress loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sync & Safeguard Your Pet Profile", "body": "Sign in to save your adoption progress and restore any existing pets linked to your account."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Environment Progress Info: Enable time estimates and desktop ready notifications on the waiting screen while the desktop pet initializes.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Setting Up Desktop Pet Workspace", "body": "Your pet is getting ready to appear on your desktop.", "notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a playground screen after home intro within onboarding is permitted by rule 4 and retains all required steps.
Adding guidance hints to the sign-in screen is valid under rule 4.
Redesigning the waiting screen while preserving its core function of showing pet creation is allowed.
Adding a quick controls guide after home intro is permitted under rule 4 and retains all required steps.
Adding informative hints to the choose path screen is permitted.
Adding quality guidance hints to the upload photos screen is valid.
Updating text copy on the home intro screen is permitted.
Reordering onboarding screens is permitted under rule 4 as all required steps remain present.
Updating reassurance copy on the sign-in screen is permitted.
Adding time estimates and ready notifications to the waiting screen during real setup is allowed under rules 4 and 5.
